faq_answer_placeholder: This is a placeholder text for the question's answer.
faq_a1: Tayseer is an Islamic platform with two main sections: a Halal Marriage section to help you find a compatible life partner, and a Consultations section where you can book sessions with certified family and relationship advisors — all in a safe, private environment.
faq_q2: What is the difference between a User and an Advisor?
faq_a2: A regular user can browse marriage profiles, book consultation sessions, and interact in the Social section. An advisor can offer paid consultation sessions, publish posts and Stories in the Social section, and create Events for their followers.
faq_q3: How does payment work in the app?
faq_a3: All payments are processed securely through Paymob directly inside the app (In-App Purchase). You can pay using credit/debit cards or digital wallets. Multiple plans are available: Basic (free), Elite, and Gold — each with different features and benefits.
faq_q4: What plans are available and what do they include?
faq_a4: The app offers three plans: Basic (free) with limited browsing, Elite with monthly sessions and post boosts, and Gold with unlimited features plus a daily free credit. You can subscribe from the Packages section in Settings.
faq_q5: What is the Social section and how does it work?
faq_a5: The Social section is an interactive community inside the app. Users can like and interact with content. Advisors can publish posts, Reels, and Stories to share their expertise and build trust with followers, helping them attract new clients.
faq_q6: How do I book a session with an advisor?
faq_a6: Go to the Consultations section, browse available advisors, choose the right one, then select the session duration (30 or 60 minutes) and your preferred time. Complete the payment via Paymob and you'll receive an instant booking confirmation.
faq_q7: How can I cancel a session?
faq_a7: You can cancel a session from the 'My Sessions' page before the scheduled time, subject to the cancellation policy. Please review the cancellation terms before confirming your booking.
faq_a8: Yes, your privacy is our top priority. All your data is encrypted and never shared with any third party without your consent. You can also enable Anonymous Mode to hide your identity while browsing the Marriage section.
